# https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/php/v1/methods/close

Source: https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/php/v1/methods/close

Closes the persistent connection to the database.
Method Syntax

```php
$db->close()
```

###  Example usage[](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/php/v1/methods/close#example-usage)

```php
$db->close();
```
